welcome_desc: A native Kotlin multi-account mail client. Messages are cached locally first and credentials are protected by Android Keystore.
leave_blank_keep_current: Leave blank to keep the current credential
authorization_code_update_note: BondMail verifies both receiving and sending before replacing the saved credential.
imap_smtp_tip: Enable IMAP/SMTP in webmail first and use an app password, not your normal web password.
netease_tip: For 163/126 Mail, enable IMAP/SMTP and generate a new client authorization code in webmail.
oauth_required: Sign in on the secure provider page to connect this mailbox. BondMail never receives or stores your provider password.
oauth_privacy_note: The provider owns the sign-in and token cache. BondMail stores only the mailbox identity and requests a short-lived access token when mail is synchronized.
oauth_google_json_hint: Android/installed client JSON works without a domain. Its package name and SHA-1 must match this APK and the Gmail API must be enabled. Web client JSON is also supported.
oauth_microsoft_json_hint: Paste or select your own MSAL JSON. redirect_uri must begin with msauth://com.bond.mail/ and match the current signing hash.
error_oauth_config_required: Add your own OAuth API JSON configuration below first.
error_oauth_config_invalid: The JSON configuration is invalid. Check the client type, Client ID, and redirect URI.
error_oauth_google_client_invalid: The Google OAuth JSON does not contain a usable Android, installed, or Web Client ID.
error_oauth_google_android_mismatch: The Android OAuth client does not match this APK. Check package com.bond.mail and the current signing SHA-1 in Google Cloud.
error_oauth_microsoft_json_invalid: The Microsoft MSAL JSON is invalid. Check client_id, MULTIPLE mode, and the msauth redirect URI for the current signing key.
error_oauth_config_read: The selected JSON file could not be read. Check that it is valid and accessible.
sync_interval_note: 1/5/10 minutes use best-effort short background polling and can be delayed by battery or Doze. 15 minutes uses periodic system work.
notification_permission_desc: BondMail can continue syncing without this permission, but Android cannot show new-mail alerts.
subject: Subject
external_link_desc: This link will open a browser or another app.
delete_account_local_only: Only local cache and local credentials will be removed. Server mail will not be deleted.
error_authorization_required: Enter the app password or authorization code.
error_authentication_failed: Authentication failed. Check IMAP/SMTP, the app password, or generate a new authorization code.
error_connection_timeout: Connection to %s timed out. Check the network and whether IMAP/SMTP is enabled.
error_host_unreachable: Cannot reach %s. Check your network, DNS, VPN, or firewall.
error_connection_failed: Could not connect to the mail server. Please try again.
error_oauth_required: This provider must be added through OAuth 2.0.
mailbox_order_desc: This order is used in the drawer, settings, and account pickers.
error_sync_timeout: Sync timed out. Check your network and try again.
mail_content_load_failed: Could not load the message content
error_oauth_reauthorization_required: Authorization expired or was revoked. Open Edit mail account and choose “Reauthorize mailbox”.
error_oauth_failed: Secure sign-in or mailbox authorization failed. Check the provider consent screen and try again.
oauth_reauthorization_note: Google and Microsoft authorization is managed by the provider. Reauthorize here after consent expires, is revoked, or the signed-in account changes—without deleting local mail.
error_oauth_account_mismatch: The signed-in mailbox does not match this account. Continue with %s.
save_draft_message: Save it to Drafts so you can continue later, or discard it permanently.
